interfaces_reviewed: the live signing state: the in-use key is ES256 (kid 55dac17b-cd6c-475d-b599-2588575f15ef; the HS256 key retired) — verified through the management API's signing-keys endpoint and the live public JWKS endpoint (both queried; names/shapes only; the JWK material is PUBLIC verification key)

the auth boundary (§8.3): ES256 ONLY (the algorithm allow-list; an HS256 token — the retired class — refuses as alg confusion), issuer/audience exact-match, expiry with leeway 0, the required claims enforced (exp/sub/iss/aud/iat)

the owner derivation (§8.4): owner_scope IS the verified sub; derive_owner accepts no client-supplied value — the signature has no owner argument, so a client value cannot travel; user_metadata is never read (not even referenced in the module)

the JWKS discipline: bounded fetch (10s timeout, 64KiB cap, https-only config), fail-closed (an unreachable JWKS REFUSES — never a fallback to accepting), an unknown kid gets exactly ONE refresh then refuses; TTL-bounded caching
